ticker_news.title: Top 10 Stocks Best Positioned to Break Out This Earnings Season
ticker_news.description: The article discusses using Investing.com's stock screener to identify high-potential stocks for the second-quarter earnings season, focusing on companies with consistent earnings growth and potential for significant performance.
ticker_news.author: David Wagner

ticker_news.title: Analysts Are Backing Qualcomm: Is a Breakout Coming?
ticker_news.description: JPMorgan upgraded Qualcomm with an Overweight rating and raised its price target to $190, suggesting potential 25% upside based on strong cloud-related spending expectations and the company's historically low P/E ratio.
ticker_news.author: Sam Quirke

ticker_news.title: D-Wave Surges 26% in July as Quantum Hype Collides With Lofty Valuation
ticker_news.description: D-Wave Quantum Inc saw a 26% stock surge in mid-July 2025, driven by technological achievements in quantum computing and investor speculation, despite ongoing challenges in achieving profitability.
ticker_news.author: Nathan Reiff

ticker_news.title: Up 1,590%, Should You Buy Nvidia at Its All-Time High?
ticker_news.description: Nvidia continues to be a leading AI technology company with remarkable financial performance, experiencing significant stock growth and establishing a dominant position in AI chip manufacturing despite potential geopolitical and economic risks.
ticker_news.author: Neil Patel
